info.name: Clozd /programs/:program Id/deals/:deal ID /programs/:program Id/deals/:deal ID API

params.name: include[]
params.description: Specifies type of data to include with deal. NOTE: Cannot include 'transcripts' without also including 'feedback' (maxItems:5)

params.name: program_id
params.description: Clozd program ID (min:36 chars, max:36 chars)

params.name: deal_id
params.description: Clozd deal ID (min:36 chars, max:36 chars)

items.docs:
Get a specific deal with details (basic fields, extra fields, (optionally) custom metadata fields, participants, products, published feedback responses, and full feedback transcript. Make sure the header is set with a key value pair being Key: x-api-token Value: (api token provided from the settings section within the Clozd application).
 - :program_id is required, you can get the program id from the settings page within the Clozd app. 
 - :deal_id is required, see /programs/:program_id/deals to
